sourceCause: Actual checked LLVM contains two private ordinary bodies and 17 global sys.runtime intrinsic wrappers. runtime.slg wrappers have a separate definition path; runtime_resolution.slg owns its single RuntimeFunctionSymbols constructor.
nextChange: Pass shared generated FunctionDefinitionPrefix through RuntimeFunctionSymbols.definitionPrefix, consumed by all declaration-named runtime wrapper definitions. No dependency cycle and no duplicated prefix literal.
